verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents `fhcli`, a command-line tool for submitting changes from existing CI or orchestration systems such as Jenkins deploys, Docker image builds and CI build statuses. It also documents a token-authenticated API that covers 'anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI', plus inbound and outbound webhooks, so headless automation is clearly supported. Missing for 10: the documented CLI scope covers only recording change and deploy events rather than full product control, there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths.
